description: Use this whenever the user asks about grid interconnection queues or how much load is waiting to connect. Call when the user asks how congested an ISO's interconnection queue is or how much data-center load is queued. Returns queued generation GW per ISO. The projects field changes shape: with iso= it is an array of per-project rows; without iso it is an all-ISO summary object (total, by_iso_count, top). ERCOT also returns its large-load (data-center) queue; other ISOs don't publish one. Keyless: a trimmed preview; free with an email-bound key. Ex: "How deep is ERCOT's queue?"

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region to drill into: ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE; omit for the all-ISO snapshot

mpp_credential.description: Autonomous payment (Stripe MPP), step 2: the Shared Payment Token you minted for challenges[0]. Set it here to pay that challenge for this single call and receive the full result — no API key, no subscription, no human. One payment covers one call.

mpp_pay.description: Autonomous payment (Stripe MPP), step 1: set true to receive a signed per-call payment challenge (the challenge states the amount) for this call instead of the free preview. No money moves — a challenge is a price quote. Humans never set this, so it does not affect the normal free/trial funnel.

name: get_interconnection_queue

outputSchema.description: ISO interconnection-queue snapshot: queued GW, per-project rows, and (ERCOT) the large-load data-center queue — alongside the DC Hub envelope keys.

_entity.description: Payload class discriminator (e.g. facility|market|iso_grid|queue_results|deal|report|response) — branch on this before parsing the rest.

_front_door.description: In-band front-door hint (first workflow-entry tool of a session): call plan_query(intent) first for the ordered multi-step plan.

_return_loop.description: Suggested next-session delta call (get_changes since=24h) so you pull only what changed.

citation.description: Machine-readable citation: how to attribute DC Hub (dchub.cloud) for this payload. Normally an OBJECT {source, url, license, cite_as, retrieved_at}; a bare string is accepted and carries the attribution line itself.

historical_completion_pct.description: Share of queued projects that historically complete, % (when published)

iso.description: ISO/RTO this snapshot covers (per-ISO drill-down form)

new_applications_q_gw.description: New queue applications in the latest period, GW (when published)

note.description: How the all-ISO rollup was assembled and where to get the full per-ISO list

top.description: The largest projects across all ISOs (same row shape as the per-ISO array form)

total.description: Projects in the full multi-ISO queue, e.g. 5512

tracked.description: Whether DC Hub has classified named per-project rows for this snapshot

projects.description: SHAPE DEPENDS ON THE CALL: with iso= this is an ARRAY of queued generation projects (largest / most recent first); with iso omitted it is the all-ISO SUMMARY OBJECT {total, tracked, by_iso_count, top, note} — per-project rows are not returned for the all-ISO snapshot. Check the type before indexing.

provenance.description: Collection-level provenance block: {source, method, as_of, verification_counts, cite_url_template, license, cite_as}. Quote the verification level when citing.

queued_generation_gw.description: Generation interconnection queue in this ISO, GW (US ISOs; ERCOT's generation queue, not its large-load queue). null on NESO/IESO/AESO

queued_generation_gw_basis_note.description: What queued_generation_gw counts on this row: status filter and MW column, e.g. "Active only, summer MW". Present on the US generation-queue ISOs other than ERCOT; compare totals from other trackers only on the same basis

queued_generation_pending_revision_gw.description: MISO only: GW of applications in Pending Revision Approval (summer MW), reported beside the active total and NOT part of queued_generation_gw. null on every other ISO, and null on the free preview like the other GW figures

queued_generation_pending_revision_gw_ba.description: What queued_generation_pending_revision_gw counts: the MISO status, MW column, and that it is excluded from queued_generation_gw. Present only when the figure is

queued_load_data_center_gw.description: ERCOT: data-center load DERIVED as ~90% of the large-load queue, GW. NESO/IESO/AESO: demand projects in the connections queue (all demand, not data centres only). null elsewhere

queued_load_dc_share_pct.description: ERCOT: data-center share of the large-load queue, %. NESO/IESO/AESO: demand share of the connections queue, %. null elsewhere

queued_load_total_gw.description: Meaning depends on queued_load_total_gw_basis: generation_queue = the generation queue (deprecated alias of queued_generation_gw, removed after 2026-11-15); large_load = ERCOT's large-load (demand) queue; mixed_connection_queue = NESO/IESO/AESO connections queue (generation AND demand). GW

queued_load_total_gw_basis.description: What queued_load_total_gw measures on this row: generation_queue | large_load | mixed_connection_queue

quota.description: Caller quota state (remaining calls, tier) when available.

site_evaluation_handoff.description: Pre-built follow-up calls (analyze_site / get_water_risk args) when the payload carries coordinates — an array of {tool, parameters, why} entries.

top_subregions.description: Provenance / sub-region breakdown for the large-load figure (ERCOT)
